div.head: Northu 3
div.ab: And gif hwilc preost agilte ⁊ he ofer biscopes gebod mæssige, gilde for ðam gebode XX ór, ⁊ þar to eacan þone gilt gebete, ðe hit ær geworhte.
And gif hwilc preost agilte and he ofer biscopes gebod mæssige, gilde for ðam gebode XX or, and þartoeacan þone gilt gebete ðe hit ær geworhte.

And if any priest commits an offence and he celebrates mass in spite of the bishop’s prohibition, he is to pay 20 ores for disregard of the prohibition, and in addition make amends for the offence which he previously committed.
And if any priest sins and he holds Mass in spite of the bishop’s command, he is to pay twenty oras for neglecting that command, and also do penance for the wrong which he committed previously.

Und wenn ein Priester schuldig wird und er [nachher] gegen des Bischofs Gebot Messe liest, so zahle er wegen des [gebrochenen] Gebots 20 Ör, und ausserdem büsse er jene Schuld, die er vor [dem Verbote] verbrochen hatte.

And if any priest does wrong and he [afterwards] says mass against the bishop's command, let him pay 20 ores for the [broken] command, and in addition atone for the offence which he committed before [the prohibition].
div.note: Thorpe corrects ‘hit’ to ‘he’. Earlier editions print XII here, wrongly.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘And if any priest commits an offence and he celebates mass in spite of the bishop's prohibition, he is to pay 20 ores for disregard of the prohibition, and in addition make amends for the offence which he previously committed.’).
